channel.title: Coltasa Insights
channel.description: Practical writing on B2B sales strategy, pipeline, outbound, negotiation and forecasting from Colin Constantine.

item.title: No champion, no deal: how to find one and make them count
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: How to find and build a champion in enterprise sales: what a real champion is, five tests that separate them from friendly coaches, and how to equip them.

item.title: When to stop selling and hand it to your first rep
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: How to know your B2B startup is ready to hand off founder-led sales, who to hire first, and a three-stage handoff that keeps deals moving.

item.title: The contract between buyers and sellers is broken
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: Mass AI outbound has buried buyers in noise. Here are practical ways to create signal again: insight people can use, handwritten notes and small events.

item.title: AI SDRs are a waste of time. For now.
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: Why AI SDRs fall short in enterprise sales today, what would need to be true for that to change, and where AI actually helps your team.

item.title: The key tenets of a mutual success plan
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: Seven principles for building a plan with your buyer that keeps deals on track, from first interest through go-live.

item.title: Write the playbook before you hire the team
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: Hiring sellers before you can explain how your deals are won is the most expensive mistake in early-stage sales. Here is what to write down first.

item.title: Never give a discount. Trade it.
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: End-of-quarter discounting teaches buyers to wait. A practical approach to enterprise negotiation that protects price and still gets deals signed.

item.title: A forecast is evidence, not optimism
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: Why most early-stage forecasts miss, and how exit criteria, deal reviews and a few honest questions make the number something you can trust.

item.title: Pick one segment and win it first
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: Early sales teams spread across too many markets. How to choose a first segment, test it and know when to expand.

item.title: How much pipeline do you actually need?
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: A simple way to work out pipeline coverage from your own numbers, and what to do when you are short.

item.title: Working with procurement, not around it
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: Procurement is part of every enterprise deal. How to bring them in early, understand what they need and keep the deal moving.

item.title: Running a discovery call that earns the second meeting
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: A practical structure for first calls with enterprise buyers, the questions worth asking and how to end with a clear next step.

item.title: Running a weekly forecast call in 30 minutes
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: A simple agenda for a weekly forecast meeting that keeps the number honest without taking over the team's week.

item.title: Writing a cold email a senior buyer will read
item.dc:creator: Colin Constantine
item.description: A practical guide to short, specific outbound emails for enterprise buyers, with a simple structure and what to leave out.
